@Test
public void testLexicographicalBinaryComparator() {
    testObjectComparator(UNSIGNED_LEXICOGRAPHICAL_BINARY_COMPARATOR, null, // ||
    Binary.fromConstantByteArray(new byte[0]), // |00|
    Binary.fromConstantByteArray(new byte[] { 127, 127, 0, 127 }, 2, 1), // |61|61|61|
    Binary.fromCharSequence("aaa"), // |61|61|61|61|
    Binary.fromString("aaaa"), // |61|61|61|62|
    Binary.fromReusedByteArray("aaab".getBytes()), // |7A|7A|7A|
    Binary.fromReusedByteArray("azzza".getBytes(), 1, 3), // |7A|7A|7A|7A|7A|7A|
    Binary.fromReusedByteBuffer(ByteBuffer.wrap("zzzzzz".getBytes())), // |7A|7A|7A|7A|7A|7A|61|
    Binary.fromReusedByteBuffer(ByteBuffer.wrap("aazzzzzzaa".getBytes(), 2, 7)), // |80|80|80|
    Binary.fromConstantByteBuffer(ByteBuffer.wrap(new byte[] { -128, -128, -128 })), // |80|FF|
    Binary.fromConstantByteBuffer(ByteBuffer.wrap(new byte[] { -128, -128, -1 }, 1, 2)));
}
